articles.title: Sabalenka opens China Open with victory and discusses self-pressure
articles.summary: Aryna Sabalenka beat Renata Zarazua to begin her China Open campaign. She explained that demanding more from herself can motivate her but can also drain her energy.

articles.title: Quebec teenager celebrates Ella's victory at World Dairy Expo
articles.summary: Alyson Doiron's favourite cow, Ella, won a top prize on Sunday at Wisconsin's World Dairy Expo, where Canadian and American farms competed.

articles.title: RuneScape animation project aims to bring Gielinor to the screen
articles.summary: Lyrical Animation is developing a RuneScape series with Jagex and creator Charlie White. The early project aims to bring the game's fantasy world to existing fans and new audiences.
